fact: The Single Social Registry (RSU) held information on more than 893,058 households as of early 2024, was mandated by Decree 2019-134 for use by all social programmes in Congo, and in 2023 the government set up the National Safety Net Program institutionalising the RSU, MIS, enrollment and payment systems.
title: CG Rep. LISUNGI Safety Nets System Project, Additional Credit (Restructuring Paper)
